findings: All eleven included NFL games are final. Reconstructed shared freeze106.26 vs first complete95.26; provisional, not settled platform scoring.

Flowers0catches/5targets followed in-game injuries to both Jackson and Huntley. Later injury evidence cannot retroactively justify the pregame pick.
Jones defenders have tackle entries and Proctor was officially inactive. Exact snaps and pressure causality remain limited; team-writer coverage concern survives favorable DST score.
interpretation: Receiving distribution was the principal miss; a team's33points and two prior efficient games did not secure the Cooper/Taylor pair.
Favorable final-v1 score does not establish collaboration improved reasoning: only one roster swap, later information and outcome variance remain confounders.

sources.scope: Attributed team-writer analysis, not an independently retrieved tracking dataset; box totals control discrepancies.

outcomes.expectation: Retains a material rushing role with receiving involvement, without an exclusive goal-line role.
outcomes.opportunity_assessment: supported: Brown led listed Bengals RB carries 12 to Perine's 4 and drew 9 targets/8 catches. Receiving involvement held; exclusive goal-line work was not claimed.
outcomes.conditions_assessment: Cincinnati threw 48 passes in an overtime game; Perine remained involved. Red-zone touch distribution and routes not independently retrieved.
outcomes.score_explanation: 17.10 from 55 rushing yards, 8 catches/46 receiving yards minus 1 lost fumble; no TD or yardage bonus.
outcomes.cutoff_judgment: Retaining a dual rushing/receiving role was supported. Strong team scoring did not ensure a Brown touchdown, and overtime affected opportunity.

outcomes.expectation: Remains a receiving participant with designed opportunities, but full-time route allocation is not established.
outcomes.opportunity_assessment: contradicted for receiving opportunities: zero targets/catches. Routes and snaps unassessable; absence from a receiving table does not mean inactive.
outcomes.conditions_assessment: Jets attempted 32 passes; Wilson 12 targets and Mitchell 9, Taylor 5. Official inactive list does not list Cooper. NBC explicitly confirms no targets; official log has blank Week8 stats.
outcomes.score_explanation: 0.00. The Cooper/Taylor pair produced only 4.90 despite 33 Jets points; team environment did not secure individual distribution.
outcomes.cutoff_judgment: Known target competition was a real risk. The receiving-participant expectation failed; two prior 100-yard games were insufficient to establish dependable opportunity. Do not invent a route or injury cause.

outcomes.expectation: Retains some receiving involvement at the low TE salary, without requiring repeated multi-TD scoring.
outcomes.opportunity_assessment: supported narrow receiving-involvement claim: 5 targets, 3 catches, 19 yards. Routes/blocking share remain unassessable.
outcomes.conditions_assessment: Hall was inactive; Braelon had 21 carries but just 2 targets. This differs from Week7 and establishes no automatic transfer of checkdowns to Taylor.
outcomes.score_explanation: 4.90 entirely catches/yards; no TD. Five targets did not repeat Week7's two-TD efficiency.
outcomes.cutoff_judgment: Hold did not require repeating touchdowns, but the low absolute receiving production hurt. Neither Hall absence nor teammate scoring predicts Taylor's role causally.

outcomes.expectation: Retains a central Browns receiving role despite a limited passing environment.
outcomes.opportunity_assessment: contradicted central target-allocation claim: Concepcion 4 of 40 listed targets (41 team attempts), versus Fannin 12 and Boston 11. Routes not retrieved.
outcomes.conditions_assessment: Browns passed for 326 gross yards but scored only 6 points, surrendered 8 sacks and lost 2 fumbles. Low points did not imply low gross passing yards.
outcomes.score_explanation: 6.70 from 3 catches/37 yards, no TD. Punt-return yards add nothing without a return TD.
outcomes.cutoff_judgment: Expected central receiving share did not persist. Prior shares were provisional; Fannin/Boston competition warranted more weight. This is one game's redistribution, not a permanent role verdict.

outcomes.expectation: DaQuan Jones and Dre'Mont Jones are expected to be available participants while Miami tackle Kadyn Proctor is unavailable; this supports the replacement's healthier-front premise, without predicting sacks or fantasy points.
outcomes.opportunity_assessment: supported availability participation: Dre'Mont and DaQuan Jones both have defensive tackle-stat entries; exact snap counts not retrieved.
outcomes.conditions_assessment: supported absence condition: Proctor officially inactive. Patriots recorded 5 sacks. Team-writer analysis reports 45% Willis pressure but continued zone weakness; causality from Proctor absence and named defenders is not isolated.
outcomes.score_explanation: 8.00 vs Jets -3.00, +11.00 at +$800. Five sacks, one interception and 19 counted PA. Weather's independent contribution cannot be established.
outcomes.cutoff_judgment: Health/protection premise had support at cutoff and observed conditions held. Positive DST delta does not erase the valid coverage counterargument, establish predictive skill, or prove the causal mechanism.
